Farmers market moves indoors for winter

The Riverside farmers market will move into the old armory building starting the first Saturday of November, organizers said, allowing vendors to keep selling through the cold months for the first time.

About twenty vendors have signed up so far, including several bakers, two cheesemakers and a family farm that sells eggs and winter greens grown in a greenhouse outside town.

The market will run from nine until one each Saturday through March. Parking is available in the lot behind the armory and along Third Street.
